question: In which of the following animals, during each cycle of blood circulation through the whole body, the blood passes through the heart only once?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fisheries**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fish have single circulation**, meaning that blood passes through the heart only once during each cycle of circulation through the body
 
• Fish **have a two-chambered heart made up of an atrium and a ventricle**. 
 
• Fish have a **single circulatory system with one circuit. **
 
• The** heart pumps deoxygenated blood to the gills**, where it becomes oxygenated.
 
• The oxygenated blood then passes to the body, and deoxygenated blood returns to the heart. 
 
• In contrast, blood passes through the heart twice during each cycle in other vertebrates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mammals**

 
 
• Mammals **can regulate their body temperature internally,** which allows them to live in a wide range of environments.
 
• Mammals **have some amount of hair or fur on their bodies**, which helps with temperature regulation.
 
• Most mammals **give live birth, although there are exceptions like monotremes (platypus, echidna) that lay eggs.**
 
• Female mammals **have mammary glands that produce milk to nourish their young.**
 
• **They have a backbone made of vertebrae.**
 
• **Examples: **Humans, dogs, whales, elephants, bats.
 
 
 
• **Reptiles**
 
 
• Reptiles **depend on external sources of heat t**o regulate their body temperature.
 
• Reptiles** have dry, scaly skin that prevents water loss and protects them from the environment.**
 
• Most r**eptiles lay eggs, although some give live birth.**
 
• Like mammals, **reptiles also have a backbone.**
 
• Reptiles breathe using lungs throughout their life.
 
• **Examples:** Snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, geckos.
 
 
 
• **Birds**
 
 
• Like mammals, **birds can regulate their internal body temperature.**
 
• Birds are characterized by f**eathers, which are unique to this class and are essential for flight, insulation, and mating displays.**
 
• All **birds lay eggs**, which are typically fertilized externally.
 
• Birds have lightweight, hollow bones that aid in flight.
 
• Birds lack teeth and instead have beaks or bills, which vary depending on their feeding habits.
 
• Like mammals and reptiles,** birds have a backbone.**
 
• **Examples: **Eagles, sparrows, penguins, ostriches, pigeons.
